reasons.1: Clear painted material planes and restrained blue/ivory/brass match the figure anchor, although fine cloth and leather texture is more persistent than its broad simplification.
reasons.2: Young sun-browned face, tied dark curls and clothing match; one diagonal satchel harness, one waist belt, left-hip bag and right-hand rod are correct, with two ring/hour-mark placements but extra shaped brass bag trim.
reasons.3: Hair, screen-left shoulder and brass ring highlights support an upper-left key; shadows remain readable and no spell source appears, though the fill is brighter and warmer than the cool low-value anchor.
reasons.4: The isolated ring head and large tied curl mass should remain distinct at 64 px, but the thin shaft and individual loose curls will lose definition.
reasons.5: Controlled painted edges and softly modeled folds agree with the anchors, with somewhat finer hair, fabric and leather rendering than the F04 figure.

ornament_surfaces: Tabard chest: one brass-colored hollow ring with one inward radial hour-mark.
Rod head: one brass ring with one inward radial hour-mark; stepped brass socket and banded foot ferrule provide additional trim.
Satchel: conspicuously shaped brass lower-corner plates and a square upper fitting; stitched flap and buckle closure are functional detailing.
Bracers: contrasting crossed laces, eyelets and outlined edges; fastening detail rather than additional symbolic motifs.
Boots: cuff, ankle and instep straps with brass buckles and stitched edging; functional detailing rather than additional symbolic motifs.
Diagonal harness and waist belt: brass buckles, holes and edge stitching; functional fittings with no additional emblem.

reasons.1: Clean illustrated folds and distinct linen, navy cloth and leather planes fit F04, with slightly more uniform surface mottling and polished modeling than the figure anchor.
reasons.2: Age, complexion, tied curls and outfit match; one diagonal satchel harness, one waist belt, left-hip bag, right-hand rod and exactly two ring/hour-mark placements are correct, but brass bag corner trim exceeds plain surfaces.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, cheek, sleeve and rod-ring highlights indicate an upper-left key without a saturated spell source; ambient illumination is less deep and cool than the light anchor.
reasons.4: The ring opening is separated clearly from the head and the tied hair makes a recognizable upper mass at 64 px, while its fringe curls and narrow rod shaft will soften.
reasons.5: Fine painted transitions and coherent edge control fit both anchors, though the fabric mottling and smoothly finished leather are more elaborate than F04's compact figure treatment.

reasons.1: Readable painted planes, restrained palette and clear materials fit the F04 figure, although diagonal tabard texture and sharply described leather remain more conspicuous than the anchor's simplification.
reasons.2: Young archivist features and outfit match with one diagonal satchel harness, one waist belt, left-hip bag and right-hand rod; two motif placements are present, but the chest tick protrudes above its ring unlike the rod tick, and bag corners carry extra brass trim.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, face, shirt folds and brass highlights support an upper-left key with readable shadows and no spell emission, but overall fill is too bright and neutral for the anchor's deep cool ambient.
reasons.4: The high ring head has a clear gap from the tied hair silhouette and both should read at 64 px, although loose curls and the slender shaft will be fragile.
reasons.5: Painted fold modeling and edge language remain consistent with the anchors; the tabard's directional texture and crisp small hardware are somewhat busier than F04.
